allow: Bash(powershell -Command "Get-CimInstance Win32_Process -Filter ""name=''claude.exe''"" | Select-Object ProcessId, CreationDate, CommandLine | Format-List")

Bash(powershell -Command "Get-CimInstance Win32_Process | Where-Object { $_.CommandLine -like ''*-p*--dangerously*'' -or $_.CommandLine -like ''*-p*--no-session*'' } | Select-Object ProcessId, Name, CreationDate, CommandLine | Format-List")
